title: Thalmor
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Thalmor: soldiers, archers, wizards, boss wizards and the named Thalmor, vanilla, DLC and CC. Only the `EncThalmor00*` templates carry a name, so every rung of a ladder shows the same one (Thalmor Soldier, Thalmor Wizard): no band is legible, and archetype-tiers.md §3.1 pins each ladder to one level (soldiers 36, wizards 44, boss wizards 45). No plugin overrides a Thalmor list or Thalmor gear list, and no quest adds to one at runtime.

families.holds: the soldier and archer ladders (4 · 12 · 20 · 28 · 36) and the wizard ladder (4 · 12 · 20 · 28 · 36 · 44), with the Justiciars, Northwatch, the Embassy, the Ratway agents, Helgen, Markarth, Solstheim and the CC Bandit Armor and Redguard soldiers
the boss wizard ladder (14 · 23 · 32 · 40 · 50), the Northwatch Interrogator and Agent Lorcalin
Elenwen, Ondolemar, Ancano, Rulindil, Estormo, Ancarion, Captain Valmir (the undercover agent at Forelhost, by the user's call), Gissur, Tsavani, J'datharr, Shavari

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the 74 CC packs that is in `ThalmorFaction` 039F26, `WEThalmorFaction` 0B80F7, `MGThalmorFaction` 0135A0, `MarkarthThalmorFaction` 0C78E5, `MQ202ThalmorAgentFaction` 06CCFB, `MQ201ThalmorCombatFaction` 039F27, `MQ201ThalmorEnemyFaction` 05450B, `WEThalmorPlayerEnemyFaction` 0B5E16 or `DLC2SV02ThalmorCrimeFaction` 02173A:Dragonborn.esm, or whose EditorID or name holds "Thalmor" or "Justiciar"; every `LVLN` whose EditorID holds "Thalmor"; then every template and list above and below them, every placed reference in every cell and worldspace, and every other record that names one of them. Everything found is on a family page except the records below. Re-checked 2026-11-12: no record outside the Thalmor pages takes a Thalmor record or list as its template, and no other list holds a Thalmor list.
